svg.title: LinkedIn Redirect Case Measures
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-linkedin-redirect-case-measures; chapter number: 6; title: LinkedIn Redirect Case Measures; subtitle: SEO Jesus ([AGcswUV4IEA @ 00:00:00]) describes the purchased asset; SEO Jesus ([AGcswUV4IEA @ 00:06:50]) displays the traffic movement.; chart type: funnel; note: The required funnel format contains separate case measures, not a conversion funnel. Dollar cost, DR, referring-domain count, and displayed traffic are different units. SEO Jesus ([AGcswUV4IEA @ 00:06:23]) says one week is too early for reliable data; SEO Jesus ([AGcswUV4IEA @ 00:09:01]) says mixed experiments and missing separate tracking links obscured attribution.; stages: label: Expired-Domain Purchase; value: 2000; display: $2,000; conversion: Asset cost, not a conversion rate. [SEO Jesus — AGcswUV4IEA @ 00:00:00]; label: Asset Domain Rating; value: 29; display: DR 29; conversion: Domain Rating, not a share of the preceding measure. [SEO Jesus — AGcswUV4IEA @ 00:00:00]; label: Asset Referring Domains; value: 144; display: 144 referring domains; conversion: Referring-domain count, not a conversion rate. [SEO Jesus — AGcswUV4IEA @ 00:00:00]; label: Displayed Traffic Before; value: 3100; display: 3,100; conversion: Displayed traffic before the redirect. [SEO Jesus — AGcswUV4IEA @ 00:06:50]; label: Displayed Traffic After; value: 7000; display: 7,000; conversion: Displayed traffic one week later; the speaker says one week is too early for reliable data. [SEO Jesus — AGcswUV4IEA @ 00:06:50] [SEO Jesus — AGcswUV4IEA @ 00:06:23]
